title: Take the World, but Give Me Jesus
lyrics: [F]Take the world, but give me [C7]Jesus, All its joys are but a [F]name;
[F]But His love abideth [C7]ever, Through eternal years the [F]same.
Oh, the [Bb]height and depth of [F]mercy! Oh, the [C]length and [G7]breadth of [C]love!
Oh, the [F]fullness of re-[C7]demption, Pledge of endless life a-[F]bove!
Take the world, but give me Jesus,
With my Savior watching o'er me,
I can sing, though billows roll.
Take the world, but give me Jesus;
Let me view his constant smile;
Light will cheer me all the while.
Take the world, but give me Jesus;
In His cross my trust shall be,
Face to face my Lord I see.
